ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

3. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
